versions.subject: Merge PR #4452 from @SILJAEUROPA  - Add New Rules To AddInUtil Potential Abuse
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\addinutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'AddInUtil.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-AddInRoot:'
        - '-PipelineRoot:'
filter_main_addinroot:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-AddInRoot:"C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\VSTA'
        - '-AddInRoot:C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\VSTA'
        - '-PipelineRoot:"C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\VSTA'
        - '-PipelineRoot:C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\VSTA'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\addinutil.exe" OR OriginalFileName="AddInUtil.exe" CommandLine IN ("*-AddInRoot:*", "*-PipelineRoot:*") NOT (CommandLine IN ("*-AddInRoot:\"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA*", "*-AddInRoot:C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA*", "*-PipelineRoot:\"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA*", "*-PipelineRoot:C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA*"))
